data.title: Seminar on Building Modern Web Applications with React.js
data.content: The Department of Information Technology, Velammal Engineering College, is organizing a seminar on 'Building Modern Web Applications with React.js'. The resource person is Mr. Siva Ganesh N, Senior Network Engineer, Movate Technologies Private Limited. The seminar will be held on July 23, 2026 (Thursday) from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM at the Mechanical Seminar Hall.

data.title: Expert Session on Future Construction: Technologies and Innovation
data.content: The Department of Civil Engineering, Velammal Engineering College, is organizing an expert session on 'Future Construction: Technologies and Innovation'. The session focuses on emerging construction technologies, innovation, Building Information Modeling (BIM), drones, smart infrastructure, and sustainable construction practices. The expert speaker is Mr. A. Thiruvikraman, Professional Service Consultant, Infinity PMC Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Chennai. The event will be held on July 24, 2026 (Friday) at 10:30 AM in the Seminar Hall, First Floor, Founder Chairman Block.
